points.text: A fire at a candy factory in Indonesia’s Banten province killed workers and left dozens missing, while rescuers reported that people were saved.
Countries at the COP31 climate summit in Turkey failed to reach a final deal amid disputes over climate finance and the energy transition.
Masked immigration officers detained two people at Seattle airport, drawing criticism from Washington officials; Homeland Security said a passenger threw hot coffee at officers.
Delta flights in and out of Atlanta were delayed by an automated aircraft weight-and-balance system issue, with staff using manual workarounds.
An explosion struck a Russian vessel docked at a naval base in Benghazi, and Libyan authorities said an initial investigation indicated a suspected drone attack.
